1.content:
QUARANTINE NOTICE: 

This facility has been placed under QUARANTINE by the Emergency Response Command.
Attempts to leave the quarantine zone will be met with SEVERE CONSEQUENCES.


Any persons who have been in contact with the affected should present themselves to the nearest ERC Emergency Station.

2.content: Well, that quarantine went great, so it did.

3.content:
PATIENT: Con Murphy.
D.O.B: 8-8-1979

ADDRESS: 12 Main Street, Skibbereen.

Patient walked into Emergency on October 28 showing signs of severe fatigue.
On inspection by Dr. Barrett, patient's BP and HR were slightly elevated, hydration was severely lacking. Suspected that patient walked from his home in West Cork.

Patient had what appears to be an animal bite on his left calf. Possible rabies is present.

4.content:
Nurses,
Had a patient walk into the hospital today, literally walk, from Skibbereen. It's fifty miles from here! His shoes were in bits, clothing ragged. He looked like death warmed up.

On top of all that he had a bite on his leg. It didn't bleed much, though there was some strange coagulation around the site.

Keep an eye on him please, something's going on there!

6.content:
Tony,

I called the chipper but got a really weird answer so I'm going down there to get the dinner myself.

7.content:
Dave,

You aren't here. You gave me your word you'd be there for me.

You lied. How am I going to get out of here? I HATE YOU!

8.content:
Dear Mammy,

Nana says I have to write goodbye to you but I dont know why. I keep hearing screams and I hope the people are ok

I miss you Mammy!

Julia

9.content:
Tiffany, I love you.
Oh God what wouldn't I give to be able to tell you this one last time.
To hold you in my arms; I would give myself to Death if that assured your safety. I wonder if you're thinking about me right now. If you ever find this Tiffany, know that I love you
- Carson

10.content:
Dear Langer,
With this whole thing going on, I thought you might stop trying to get off with me. But no. You kept at it. I'd kill you, but I'm too nice for that. So I'm sabotaging your little escape plan.

Have fun with your burning boat.
- Violet <3

11.content:
Dear Jenny,
If you're reading this, I fear my life will soon end. I know the chances of you finding this note are very slim. Please don't worry about me. Just try to get the kids out of Cork. Know that I love you and the kids dearly. Not a moment goes by I don't think about you.
- John

12.content:
Roxanne,

Went looking for Tommy at his school. I found him, he was with friends, all turned into those 'things'. Bit me good in the hand.

DON'T COME LOOKING FOR US.

I'm sorry, I tried.

Love, John.

13.content: Release the souls of the blessed and the damned. I am not your keeper. Oh God forgive me, for I have sinned.

14.content:
The screaming in the air is getting louder, the rain is turning more sour by the day, I long for a home, for peace.

I'm free now, from this wretched hell.

-Valentine

15.content:
Dear Carly,
Jessie left, she went east after hearing that broadcast, the old house is bad news, there's a lot of them around it now so I set out north, I hear it's much safer up there. I hope you understand I thought a lot of you and I wish you never went back for Jake, watch yourself.
Love Curtis

16.content: It's the Government. I know it's the Government. It's always the Government. They want to kill us all. They'll declare martial law and erase our rights. They're in cahoots with the aliens and the Brussels crowd. I've always known it. Who's the fool now?

17.content:
This place is not safe! Nowhere is safe!

You will die just like the rest of us. Abandon hope. Abandon God like he abandoned us.

18.content:
Honey,
They closed the shop with me in it! It's been days and all I've heard is screaming.

I'm fairly sure no-one is coming for me, I suppose this is goodbye.

I love you, baby.

19.content:
What's going on? First 'Cult murders' then 'cannibals' now they tell everyone to go here or there, telling different people different things.

God, the Army isn't even giving their own soldiers orders. WHAT THE HELL IS HAPPENING?

20.content:
Note:
Morality Today's not the day for that. It's every man for himself now. Survival instinct overrides compassion and reason. Don't hesitate behind the trigger- those things just aren't people anymore. We can cry when this is all over.

22.content:
Hey Jon,

I've a stall set up in the English Market in return for all the artwork you used in that vampire game you're making.

If you could mention it in the game somehow that'd be great.

Cheers, Boothy.

23.content: Saw a woman with her baby today. She was feasting on her. Put both out of their misery without a flinch...What's happening to me?

24.content:
Roger,
Heading north, heard it was safe. I don't know though. I've been to so many 'safe havens' that were overrun by Them. I don't know what to do anymore. The kids are scared. I'm not the religious one, but I tell you, I've prayed so much my hands hurt. Hope it helps. God be with us?
Good Luck, Aaron

25.content:
Albert,

Things have gone horribly wrong. Meet me in Boston.

Love, Jill.

26.content:
Tommy,
Remember what I told you and always respect, protect and obey your father and always remember that I love you so much. I am going to leave you forever because I am too sick to go on. Bless you my Son and when your time comes to go. You will find me waiting for you.
Mom.

27.content:
Note to self: Trust costs food. 

Next eejit who knocks at my door looking for a place to stay has to pay up. I can't afford to give everyone a free pass, especially after that last guy turned on me in the middle of the night. --Eli

28.content: To anyone who reads this: I see it everywhere. I can't get rid of it. It tells me to kill and I do, hoping it goes away. But no matter how many of those things I kill it comes back. Words, thoughts, death, always in my head. I end it all to protect people like you and to stop it. Goodbye.

29.content:
Dear Diary,
 Yesterday a strange man bit me on the arm. It's starting to really hurt and it smells really really bad, Hopefully mammy won't notice it and send me away like she did daddy. Mammy says we are leaving to go on a short holiday tomorrow, it sounds like fun but I wish daddy was coming with us.

30.content:
R.I.P.- Gino Genson

Fought off and killed 21 infected before succumbing to his wounds

31.content: If the people had defended the city instead of falling into panic, it wouldn't be lost.

35.content: Finally decided to kill him. Collect insurance to pay off my flat. Put pills in his tea. Went to loot whatever food I could find. He was up when I got home. Bastard bit me. Beat him to death again with a hammer. Can feel the death in my veins, almost turning. Horrible time for an apocalypse, God. I deserve it.

36.content:
Nina,

Everything went to hell. The flat is just a wrecked mess. I hid in the wardrobe, but you're not going to find me here, leave while you can.

Just leave across the sea now!

Good-bye Nina, Love Chris

37.content:
This is the way the world ends
This is the way the world ends
This is the way the world ends
Not with a bang but a moan

38.content:
And the LORD will send a plague on all the nations.
Their people will become like walking corpses, their flesh rotting away.
Their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
On that day they will be terrified, stricken by the LORD with great panic.

50.content:
Honey I'll be back by the time you get back.

I locked the keys to the warehouse inside the safe, now I can't find the damn things, going back to the house to find them.

Wait here!
